SELECT d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS driver_name, COUNT(*) AS podiums
FROM results r
JOIN races ra ON r.raceId = ra.raceId
JOIN drivers d ON r.driverId = d.driverId
WHERE ra.year = 2009
  AND r.position IN (1, 2, 3)
GROUP BY r.driverId
ORDER BY podiums DESC, driver_name;

WITH driver_podiums AS (
    SELECT 
        d.driverId,
        d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS driver_name,
        COUNT(*) AS podium_count
    FROM results r
    JOIN races ra ON r.raceId = ra.raceId
    JOIN drivers d ON r.driverId = d.driverId
    WHERE ra.year = 2009
        AND r.position <= 3
        AND r.position IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY d.driverId, d.forename, d.surname
)
SELECT driver_name
FROM driver_podiums
WHERE podium_count = (SELECT MAX(podium_count) FROM driver_podiums)

WITH podiums AS (
  SELECT r.driverId, COUNT(*) AS podium_count
  FROM results r
  JOIN races ra ON r.raceId = ra.raceId
  WHERE ra.year = 2009
    AND r.position IN (1,2,3)
  GROUP BY r.driverId
),
max_podiums AS (
  SELECT MAX(podium_count) AS max_cnt FROM podiums
)
SELECT d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS driver_name
FROM podiums p
JOIN drivers d ON p.driverId = d.driverId
JOIN max_podiums m ON p.podium_count = m.max_cnt
ORDER BY driver_name;
